extraInstructions: IMPORTANT: Do NOT use speechManager.speak() anywhere in the game. Only use audioManager.play() for sound effects. Valid sound effects: pickup, drop-correct, drop-wrong, tap, success, error, celebration, hint. The game must teach: (1) External body parts — head, eyes, ears, nose, mouth, neck, shoulders, arms, elbows, hands, fingers, chest, stomach, legs, knees, ankles, feet, toes. (2) Sense organs — eyes see, ears hear, nose smells, tongue tastes, skin feels touch. (3) Each organ does only its own work. Misconceptions: 'eyes eat food' (eyes see, they don't eat), 'knee and elbow are the same' (elbow is on arm, knee is on leg), 'this is my hand pointing at wrist' (palm is flat part, fingers are long parts, wrist joins hand to arm). Default width=720, height=560. Use named export (export function BodyGame), NOT export default. Export interface BodyGameProps with width?, height?, onComplete?: (score: number) => void.
